name.en-US: The Book of the Seven Enclosures

description.dum: Brief aan de zusters over de zeven 'sloten' van het kloosterleven. Middelnederlandse tekst van J. B. David (1861).
description.en-US: A letter to the Poor Clare nuns of Brussels on the seven enclosures of the religious life. The Middle Dutch text of J. B. David (1861).
description.pt-BR: Carta às Clarissas de Bruxelas sobre os sete cercados da vida religiosa. Texto em neerlandês médio de J. B. David (1861).

sources.edition: Jan van Ruusbroec, Werken, ed. J. B. David, deel 4: Dat boec van seven sloten. (Gent: Maetschappy der Vlaemsche Bibliophilen, 1861).
sources.description: Keyed text from DBNL (TEI XML, 'auteursrechtvrij'), converted by research/sourcing/_scripts/rhineland/ruus_build.py. Line-end hyphens joined; page and line breaks dropped. David's apparatus is kept as footnotes (manuscript variants F, G, I, L, M, D, Surius' Latin readings 'Sur.'). David's Dutch preface, manuscript list, misprint list and glossary are not included.
sources.tierEvidence: Nineteenth-century critical edition, marked 'Auteursrechtvrij' on DBNL.
